discovery.note: Pinnacle no-vig home probability vs Polymarket sampled home price; 10-minute grid because the 1-month Polymarket lookback is sampled every 10 minutes.

calibration.common_definition: per league, the games where every eligible source has a value: sportsbook closes within 6 h of kickoff, the consensus, and Polymarket samples at T−24 h (≤ 120 min old), T−1 h (≤ 60 min) and T−1 min (≤ 30 min); a source is eligible when it quotes at least half of the league's games
calibration.outcome: home team wins (soccer draw = 0; ties excluded)

calibration_extended.common_definition: per league, the games where every eligible sportsbook has a close within 6 h of kickoff (a book is eligible when it quotes at least half of the league's games)
calibration_extended.outcome: home team wins (soccer draw = 0; ties excluded)
calibration_extended.sources: sportsbooks only (Polymarket not fetched for the extension)

backtests.stake: 1 USD per bet, hold to resolution, Polymarket taker fee charged on entry (fee = shares × rate × p × (1 − p)); no exit, no slippage, fill assumed at the sampled price
backtests.placebo: outcome labels shuffled across the strategy's bets, 500 shuffles, seed 17

in_game.note: Polymarket samples are 1-5 minutes apart; 'next sample' is the first sample at or after the play's Sportradar wall clock.

context.caveat: 29 group comparisons are shown; with a 5% level about 1.5 would look 'significant' by chance. Bonferroni-adjusted level: 0.0017. Residual = outcome − Pinnacle closing probability (home).
